purpose: Define deterministic pre-rendered carousel rotation sampling so alternating canopy stripes remain coherent in the 2D runtime animation.

sampling.sampleAngles: frame n uses (n-1)*7.5 degrees for n=1..48

reviewProxy.reason: Avoid 30-degree stripe-period aliasing that makes the canopy appear stationary in review.

colorMask.synchronization: mask frame and beauty frame must use the same direction, frame index, pivot, canvas and rotor angle

validation: primary plus secondary stripe counts must equal 24
review proxy must sample 24 frames at 15 degree visual steps to avoid 30 degree stripe aliasing
exported frame 48 must represent 352.5 degrees, not 360 degrees
frame 49 exists only as the non-exported loop closure key
beauty and color-mask frame ordering must match
